turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
Take your time.
I have not weighed myself for two weeks, and I gave the scale to Aisha to hide.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. Yes, it was like that.
What happened next?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
How did that feel for you?
Bridget says my weight is steady and the number does not scare me as much.
What happened next?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. Yes, it was like that.
How did that feel for you?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
Take your time.
The family session with my parents and Bridget is booked for the twenty-fourth of March.
How did that feel for you?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Tell me more about that.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Take your time.
My father took the train to Edinburgh and we had lunch, I ate a whole sandwich in front of him.
Tell me more about that.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. It is not easy to talk about.
And how was that for you?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
